Corollary
[Gluing Lemma for Smooth Maps]

↗ prop:2-6

1. ch2:2.8If $\{ U_\alpha \} _{\alpha \in A}$ is an open cover of $M$ and smooth maps $F_\alpha :U_\alpha \to N$ agree on every overlap, there is a unique smooth $F:M\to N$ with $F|_{U_\alpha }=F_\alpha $.
